notes: Paper Mario decomp and ReCut are exact upstream pins cloned into gitignored ref/.
N64ModernRuntime and RT64 are vendored inside the ReCut checkout at its pin.
Source checkouts are local build inputs; redistribution remains subject to RIGHTS_AND_LICENSES.md.

paperMarioReCut.provenance: SMCGames ReCut main; vendors N64ModernRuntime + rt64

mupen64plusRspHle.provenance: Pinned HLE NAUDIO backend used by the Paper Mario runtime

sdl2.provenance: SDL 2.32.10 source for native macOS and Apple mobile builds

zstd.provenance: zstd 1.5.6 source; supplies the upstream CMake files omitted from the flattened ReCut vendor tree

decomp.notes: Host GNU cpp required by the decomp configure step (macOS ships only clang cpp).
